name: Template flush reports busy with 1 referenced templates and preserves all objects
setup: $TC p4template create pipeline/flushRules pipeid 22 numtables 2
$TC p4template create extern/root/ext1 extid 1 numinstances 2
$TC p4template create extern_inst/flushRules/ext1/one instid 1 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 param value ptype bit32
$TC -j p4template get extern/root/ext1 >/tmp/p4tc-flush-$TESTID-1.json
verifyCmd: sh -c 'set -eu; python3 -c '"'"'import sys; assert open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines()[0] == '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'Error: Unable to flush any externs.'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"''"'"' /tmp/p4tc-flush-$TESTID.err; $TC -j p4template get extern/root/ext1 | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; assert json.load(sys.stdin)==json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))'"'"' /tmp/p4tc-flush-$TESTID-1.json; $TC -j p4template get extern_inst/flushRules/ext1/one; $TC p4template del extern_inst/flushRules/ext1/one; $TC p4template del extern/root/; $TC p4template create extern/root/ext1 extid 1 numinstances 2; printf flushed'
teardown: sh -c 'set -eu; for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/flushRules 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf "%s\n" "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
